our_interpretation: The surrounding sentence about progress on some measures but not others makes not all the intended reading of the apparent typo not at all.
The test concerns the original June 2022 BIG-bench paper and its evaluated model sizes.

The reference to the earlier essay is assessed as corroboration of its limited contention that improvement was uneven across measures. It is not treated as proof of every argument in that essay or of a permanent scaling barrier.
criteria.support_condition: The original BIG-bench report finds broad improvements with model scale alongside tasks or measures that do not improve over the tested range.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The original report finds improvement on all tested measures, or fails to report the claimed coexistence of improving and non-improving performance.
